tasks.name: Write tests for feedback_state transitions in apply_event
tasks.description: Inline #[cfg(test)] mod tests in crates/common/src/services/project_runtime.rs. Assert: AgentStatusChanged{lifecycle:"awaiting_permission"} sets lifecycle=AgentLifecycle::AwaitingPermission AND feedback_state=permission_request (FR1.2); the starting/running/idle arms set feedback_state=none (FR1.3); AgentStopped and RuntimeError each reset feedback_state to none from permission_request (FR1.4); reconcile paths never touch feedback_state (FR1.7). Confirm all fail before implementing.

tasks.name: Implement feedback_state and the apply_event arms
tasks.description: Add the provider-neutral feedback state enum (none | permission_request | user_question) to the runtime agent sub-state in crates/common (FR1.1). Add the awaiting_permission arm to apply_event's AgentStatusChanged match, which currently falls through to _ => AgentLifecycle::Stopped, setting lifecycle and feedback_state in the SAME arm so they cannot drift (FR1.2). Set feedback_state=none on the starting/running/idle arms and unconditionally on AgentStopped/RuntimeError (FR1.3, FR1.4). Never set user_question anywhere (FR1.5). Note the existing oneshot_watcher_service AwaitingPermission branch becomes live once this lands — verify its existing test still passes rather than assuming it.

tasks.name: Add content-free tracing for feedback_state transitions
tasks.description: Write tests first for a small record-formatting helper, then implement it and call it from apply_event. One structured record per transition: timestamp, worktree_id, triggering event kind, old state, new state (FR1.6). Tests must assert the record contains no prompt, tool, terminal, or branch content and no control token. The runtime-event path has zero tracing calls today, so this is the first; keep it to the transition only, not general event logging.
